{{quotation|[[gw.dat]]|The docks here have traditionally been used by boats heading for [[Cantha]] and [[Tyria]].}}
The [[Sun Docks]] is the primary docking area used by foreigners arriving from across the sea to the island of [[Istan]]. Those crossing from the [[Elona|Elonian]] mainland tend to stop at the [[Consulate Docks (outpost)|docks]] on north side of [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan|Kamadan]] instead.

[[Nightfall]] characters are directed here to meet with [[Zaishen Order|Zaishen]] delegates from [[the Battle Isles]], while characters from other [[campaign]]s enter the Nightfall campaign for the first time from this location.

==Getting there==
Enter from an eastern portal in Kamadan that's right across a small bridge. The primary quest [[Bad Tide Rising]] will require Nightfall characters to come here.

Characters from the [[Prophecies]] campaign and the [[Factions]] campaign arrive here as part of the [[Sunspears in Kryta]] or the [[Sunspears in Cantha]] quest respectively.

==Notes==
{{gw2w|The Sun Docks}}
*Complete exploration of this area contributes less than 0.1% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. This area is included in the exploration value for [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]]
*During [[Special events|Festival events]], Kamadan will not display any of the festive decorations when viewed from inside the Sun Docks, but when looking at the Sun Docks area from the Kamadan side of the portal, Sun Docks appears to be festively decorated (for example, during Wintersday, there is snow on the ground, but upon entering Sun Docks, there is no snow).
